physical_authority: none; A alone owns build, AXI, pins, board and START

configuration.capture: one accepted rising-edge arm only; held high is not a second arm; immutable through 12 accepted records and 4 frames

scan_input.handshake: valid must remain asserted until ready; high ready is wrapper eligibility only; the unchanged aggregate is the sole storage authority and may refuse a presented channel/sequence/quality/stride violation without storing or relabelling it

s_acq_qpc_ns.max: bit63 must be 0; exact same value for all four lanes in a scan; nonwrapping and regular positive stride

s_quality.semantics: opaque caller-supplied quality; constant per channel across scans; not transported on TRACE wire

s_tag.rule: nonzero and equal to captured cfg_tag

s_native_first_seq.rule: base+0..11 across 12 records without uint32 wrap

refuse_without_correction: nonpositive, irregular, non-whole-microsecond or out-of-range QPC stride
configuration base-frame-sequence wrap or zero tag

outputs.wire_first_index: original batch base native first sequence + channel
outputs.wire_relative_first_tick: derived from captured origin; no current-clock rebasing
outputs.result_contract: result_valid/result_ready, result_error 3 bits, result_bytes 6 bits; result is held under backpressure
outputs.accepted_lanes: current collector count 0..12; not an optimistic handshake count

control.cancel: abort accepted/in-flight work; abort_code=1; no replay; fresh ARM needed
control.disable: withdraw enable; abort accepted/in-flight work; abort_code=2; restoration alone does not ARM
control.refusal: refused/refusal_code; partial emitted bytes remain invalid; no rollback

refusal_code.15: egress association or downstream result error

upload_byte_boundary.schema: opaque bytes; no invented companion parser or authentication

provenance_and_gaps.source_provenance: caller-supplied; not authenticated by this RTL
provenance_and_gaps.test_execution: not run; no FAKE_CSR execution in this work
